description.text: "This program requires students to master international economics's theory and method, grasp the basic knowledge and skill of international commecial activites, understand the development of international economics and international trade thoery, and can skillfully conduct business activities by applying international rule and foreign languages. Graduates can become business representatives for international business activities,international business engineer and senior management personnel of internationalized operation in international firms, oriented enterprizes and foreign-owned company. Major Courses: Management Thoery, Micro-economics, Macro-economics, Accounting, International Economics, Financial Administration, International Marketing, International Finance, International Trade Law, Currency Banking, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor’s Degree in Management"

duration.text: The International Business at Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2444 USD/per year ￥ 17600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Only for applicants who wish to apply for Chinese-medium courses. 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 7. Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency.

requirements.text: Aged under 25 years old, High school graduate or equivalent or above, Be able to take courses in Chinese (passing HSK Level 4).
